# Security policy

OpenCongregationHelper stores personal data of the members of a congregation: please report security vulnerabilities
privately, never in a public issue, pull request or discussion.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Open a report from the [Security tab](https://github.com/OpenCHelper/OpenCongregationHelper/security/advisories/new)
of the repository, describing:

- what the vulnerability allows (e.g. reading the territories of another congregation, signing in as another user);
- the steps to reproduce it, on a local installation or on the
  [public demo](https://github.com/OpenCHelper/OpenCongregationHelper#demo) (never on a real installation);
- the version where you found it.

Do not include real congregation data (names, addresses, phone numbers...) in the report.

You will receive an answer as soon as possible; once the vulnerability is fixed, a new release is published and the
report becomes a public security advisory, crediting you unless you prefer otherwise.

## Supported versions

Only the latest release receives security fixes: keep your installation up to date.
